meta.name: writing-skills
meta.description: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建编辑并验证自定义技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在维护自己的技能包，需要经常创建、调整并确保它们能正常工作。
copy.tagline_en: Create, edit, and validate your custom skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a set of custom skills and need to create, update, and verify them regularly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按“先测试、后写文档”的方式创建技能:先设计压力场景、观察当前失败,再写 SKILL.md,验证后修补漏洞;产出含触发条件和正文的技能文档。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 创建新技能、修改已有技能,或在部署前检查技能是否可用时触发。

say.text: 创建一个新技能,先用测试场景验证再写 SKILL.md
say.note: Claude 先观察无技能时的失败,再编写文档。

say.text: 帮我审查这个技能的 description,去掉流程总结
say.note: 按发现优化规则,确保 description 只写触发条件。

say.text: 按 TDD 方式重写这个技能,先写失败测试

howto.what_en: Claude creates skills via test-first: design scenarios, see baseline fail, write SKILL.md, verify compliance, patch loopholes. Output: a skill doc with triggers, body, and optional files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create a new skill, edit an existing skill, or verify a skill works before deployment.

say_en.text: Create a new skill, starting with a failing test before writing SKILL.md.
say_en.note: Claude designs a pressure scenario and observes failure without the skill.

say_en.text: Review this skill's description and remove any workflow summary.
say_en.note: Checks that the description only states triggering conditions.

say_en.text: Rewrite this skill using TDD, writing the failing test first.
